verdict.rationale: The IRS runs online services and machine intake channels (MeF, IRIS A2A), so asking whether a user can issue scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question. The evidence shows no such capability. MeF and IRIS A2A are reached only through provider enrollment and a Transmitter Control Code, not self-issued, least-privilege keys. Online Account sign-in is an ID.me biometric liveness check, and the EIN third-party designee path is paper-based signed authorization, which is an adjacent control rather than scoped API credentials.
